title: A server-side api read slower than 3 s shows the not-found page: Submittals List, Kanban and Snag List are unreachable for TMC at 858 items (also SUB-27 Home, SNG-13, PKG-08, SMOKE)
Home takes 18–19 s and the Lists 3–4.4 s at 858 work items: the api reads do not scale to one real Project (also the Project Dashboard, SUB-26)
A Member who is not the Authorized Person cannot open Company Projects (403; the page sends him Home), against visibility rule V15
Inviting a Member sends no email: the invitee can only join with the token the api returns to the inviter (also journey J13)
Documental Record: "Prepared" is dated at the raiser's first send out of Draft, which was Returned, not at the last one (visibility rule V7)
Photo annotation (RP-656) is reachable from no page: the tool is built but no web page shows it
The raw translation key workItems.form.checklistTemplateField.raisesSnag shows on Checklist Templates and the WIR's checklist (also UX-18)
List column headers and the Group by menu use terms the glossary avoids: Status, Discipline, Current owner (also SUB-23)
